notes.title: Hand of Doom is now Available on Steam
notes.content:
[h3]It's finally time, wizards! [/h3]
[b][i]Hand of Doom[/i] is now available for purchase on Steam[/b]! Journey through sprawling environments as you learn new ways to inflict doom and destruction on your foes, meet colorful characters, all while making arcane hand signs and listening to a dope soundtrack! 

[previewyoutube=vzqk8iFkoQE;full][/previewyoutube]

[i][h2]Pick up Hand of Doom Now![/h2][/i]
